objectives.text: Govern on the mandate of 12 May 2026: the Progressive Liberal Party under Philip Davis was re-elected for a second straight term, with 33 of 41 seats in the preliminary count, after Davis called an early vote. That mandate is the constraint on every choice below.

objectives.text: Control irregular migration, above all from Haiti: after the May 2026 election the government stepped up removals (107 Haitians flown out in May, 116 on 27 August 2026) and announced a biometric immigration system, stiffer penalties for employers and daily overstay fines.

means.text: Tourism as the main earner, now tilted to cruise: the World Bank reports cruise arrivals up 11.6 per cent year on year through October 2025, while stayover visitors fell 1.9 per cent.

constraints.text: Tourism is most of the economy: a US Commercial Service guide puts tourism at about 50 per cent of GDP (more with related services), and the stayover base is flat, so a hurricane, a change in US travel rules or a shift in the cruise mix hits the same sector.

paradoxes.text: The Bahamas refuses to take US deportees, yet removes Haitians on its own flights at scale (107 in May 2026, 116 on 27 August 2026). It says it cannot receive migrants from Washington while it runs the same kind of removals itself, so its refusal and its removals sit side by side.

grand_strategy.reading: The Bahamas is a small, tourism-dependent state whose government was renewed in May 2026 with a large majority, so its aim is continuity and control of migration rather than a change of course. Its sharpest test is with Haiti and the United States: Nassau removes Haitians at scale and bars Haitian visa applicants, in line with Washington's entry rules, while it refuses to take US deportees. This card holds only what was sourced in this pass; its positions on Cuba, China, CARICOM and Ukraine or Gaza are not written, because no source for them was read.

stances.note: Transactional and close, with no treaty. The US ambassador calls the Bahamas a valued partner (January 2026). Nassau refused US deportation flights in 2024 and in 2025 barred Haitian visa applicants after Washington restricted Haitian entry. Bond affinity: close ties without grievance. The grade is our reading (C): the only source using the word is the ambassador's own phrase.
